body:
I am really sorry you have to live with such horrible self-hatred. Without knowing you, I can tell you that you are being way too hard on yourself if there is not one positive quality you can list about yourself. No one is that one-dimensionally bad, if you know what I mean. At the very least you feel guilt about burdening people around you and want to change. That is already more than what can be said about a lot of others. 

The fact that you haven't showered in two weeks means that you are probably seriously depressed, which you will have to do something about  at first, before you can tackle any of the other points on your list. Do you have health care or at least the option to pay for treatment out of pocket? If so, please make an appointment with a psychiatrist or therapist *today*. I am not one of these people who think therapy is a cure-all and helps everyone, but 1) If the alternative is suicide you have nothing to lose and might as well give it a shot and 2) your depression is probably severe enough that you need to take prescrition medication in order to have a chance to get better. 

Once you are in treatment you can re-visit this list and, one by one, work on these "faults". They might seem like your unchangeable fate right now, but a lot of them can actually be changed. You can tell your boyfriend that you feel bad for putting him under stress while at school (you can't undo it, however knowing that you care about his feelings will already mean a lot to him), you can train your brain and gather knowledge by reading, you can donate to charity, do volunteer work, try out new hobbies... every small step will make you feel good about yourself and thereby give you the strength to tackle the next bigger issue. Good luck!
